name: name
doc: The name of the mod in the mod list. Not required by the parser, empty if missing

name: description
doc: The description of the mod in the mod list. Not required by the parser, empty if missing

name: request_no_api_restrictions
doc: If 1 the mod's lua state opens the full LuaJIT library set (package/require, io, os, debug, ffi) and keeps load/loadstring/collectgarbage. The player must allow unsafe mods, and such mods don't work through the Steam Workshop

name: ui_newgame_name
doc: Game mode name shown in the new game menu. Only used with is_game_mode="1". Accepts $translation keys

name: ui_newgame_description
doc: Game mode description shown in the new game menu. Only used with is_game_mode="1". Accepts $translation keys

name: ui_newgame_gfx_banner_bg
doc: Path to the background image of the game mode's new game menu banner, e.g. mods/<id>/files/menu_banner_background.png

name: ui_newgame_gfx_banner_fg
doc: Path to the overlay image of the game mode's new game menu banner, e.g. mods/<id>/files/menu_banner_overlay.png

name: is_game_mode
doc: If 1 this mod is a game mode: it isn't enabled from the mod list but started from the new game menu, using the ui_newgame_* attributes

name: game_mode_supports_save_slots
doc: If 1 a game mode (is_game_mode="1") supports multiple save slots

name: is_translation
doc: If 1 normal mod functionality is turned off and the mod is listed under Language in the options menu instead, using translation_xml_path and translation_csv_path

name: translation_xml_path
doc: Path to the <Language> xml of a translation mod (language key, name, fonts, UI offsets), e.g. mods/<id>/translation.xml

name: translation_csv_path
doc: Path to the translation csv of a translation mod, e.g. mods/<id>/translation.csv
